Automatic Execution Paths

  • entry_points.txt defines amz-ads = amazon_ads_cli.main:cli, which is a normal CLI entry point requiring user invocation.
  • No .pth, sitecustomize.py, usercustomize.py, PEP 517 build hooks, or malicious import-time side effects were identified in the provided files.

Theft / Exfiltration / Persistence / Lateral Movement / Obfuscation

  • Credential-related code is limited to documented interactive setup/display for a single Amazon Ads API credentials file at ~/.config/python-ad-api/credentials.yml. There is no evidence of broad environment, .env, SSH key, cloud credential, or CI token discovery.
  • The pre-scan hits for gzip.decompress(response.content) and requests.get(url) appear to be user-invoked logic for downloading and decompressing GZIP_JSON reports from the Amazon Advertising Reports API. There is no evidence of harvested-file archiving, staging, or external upload.
  • No persistence mechanisms such as systemd units, cron jobs, shell profile edits, Kubernetes/CI/cloud lateral movement, obfuscated eval/exec loaders, self-deleting droppers, or downloader stubs were found.

  • No unexplained native binaries, hidden payloads, suspicious extra files, or evidence supporting dependency confusion/typosquatting were identified from the provided contents.
